title: AI-based Semiconductor Design Automation and Optimization
summary: AgileSoDA reports that its reinforcement-learning physical-design system cut floor-planning time in partner deployments by 76%, from more than a week to roughly a day.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AgileSoDA and ASICLAND announced their chip design partnership in January 2023. ASICLAND is a data and deployment partner. In its submission to the ITU AI for Good report of 2025, AgileSoDA reports that partner deployments cut floor-planning time by 76%, from more than a week to roughly a day. It also reports that overall duration fell by 20% for high-density designs. These aggregate first-party results are not allocated to individual designs. On 8 December 2025 the Korean newspaper Hankyung reported that a KOSDAQ-listed company had tested the placement tool in a TSMC process. Hankyung cited no named source and gave no outcome figures. It also reported that AgileSoDA was still developing ChipNSoDA.
purpose: Automate semiconductor placement and floor-plan optimization.

ratings.reason: AgileSoDA reports 76% less floor-planning time, from more than a week to roughly a day, across partner deployments.
Higher-value work and professional development for engineers are expected consequences, and no source measures them.

ai_role.statement: Reinforcement learning automates physical chip layout and floor planning. The reported time reductions are attributed to this design workflow, without an independent component comparison.

evidence.citation: AgileSoDA, Use Case 2 (Manufacturing) in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, Report 2025. Project-submitted account by the developer, current as of June 2025. It gives no dates, design counts or method for its figures, and ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.

data.answer:
AgileSoDA reports that partner deployments cut floor-planning time by 76%, from more than a week to roughly a day. The figures are first-party aggregate claims.

The 76% reduction applies to floor planning in reported partner work, while the source also gives smaller overall-duration improvements. It cannot represent a 76% reduction in the complete chip-design process. Design-quality checks, sample sizes, and realized production effects remain unverified.

display.answer: The floor-planning figures come from AgileSoDA's own submission to the ITU AI for Good report of 2025. Hankyung reported on 8 December 2025 that a KOSDAQ-listed company had tested the placement tool in a TSMC process, citing no named source, and it gave no figures on design time.
The geopolitical implications are unclear.

fields.summary: AgileSoDA reports that its reinforcement-learning physical-design system cut floor-planning time in partner deployments by 76%, from more than a week to roughly a day.
fields.account: AgileSoDA and ASICLAND announced their chip design partnership in January 2023. ASICLAND is a data and deployment partner. In its submission to the ITU AI for Good report of 2025, AgileSoDA reports that partner deployments cut floor-planning time by 76%, from more than a week to roughly a day. It also reports that overall duration fell by 20% for high-density designs. These aggregate first-party results are not allocated to individual designs. On 8 December 2025 the Korean newspaper Hankyung reported that a KOSDAQ-listed company had tested the placement tool in a TSMC process. Hankyung cited no named source and gave no outcome figures. It also reported that AgileSoDA was still developing ChipNSoDA.
